links.to_node: I do not test the new, lightweight combat gear.
I do not experience reduced protection against bruises during training exercises.
I do not contribute to data on the benefits of lighter combat gear.
The military continues to shift towards less protective but more agile gear regardless of my testing.
I maintain current levels of protection in training without increased risk from lighter gear.
I avoid potential injuries that could result from testing less protective gear.
